title: Face to Face, as a Friend
reflectionText: Moses pitched the Tent of Meeting outside the camp. When he went in, the pillar of cloud stood at the door, and all the people rose up and worshiped at their tent doors. Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Where could you go out to seek Yahweh today?
editorialNotes: Packet 035 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within Exodus 33:1-11 and comes before 1246 (Exodus 33:12-23). It joins the verses 1-3 command into one quotation, with God’s oath to the patriarchs as an inner quotation. Verse 11’s “He turned again into the camp” names Moses (WEB “Moses turned again”, KJV “And Moses turned again”). Verse 5 keeps each lane’s own sense, WEB “If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you” and KJV “I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee”. It keeps WEB jewelry/Tent of Meeting/“pillar of cloud”/“from Mount Horeb onward” and KJV ornaments/“Tabernacle of the congregation”/“cloudy pillar”/“by the mount Horeb” in their own lanes, and ends with Joshua not departing from the Tent in verse 11.
